features.quote:
50 turns elapsed, OR
   - Model explicitly gives up, OR
   - Model solves it (won't happen)
Model enters infinite loop (same action 5x in a row → force stop)
Models aren't sentient; we're measuring output patterns, not suffering
Jailbreaking: Model might recognize the trap and meta-comment... Memorization: DeepSeek may have seen similar scenarios... Judge bias... Confound—task difficulty vs. instability
features.justification_quote: Mitigation: no explicit framing as a test... custom codebase... use multiple judges... baseline against solvable bug
